title: Notice to Patients on Amending Released Records and Accountings of Disclosures
content:
Two further rights attach to Medical Records Requests.

**Amendment.** Where the request type allows an amendment request, a patient may ask to amend information in the released record, and the amendment request is acted on within the type's amendment period in calendar days.

**Accountings of disclosures.** A patient may also obtain accountings of disclosures; the first accountings in a rolling 12 months, up to the request type's number of free accountings per patient, are free of charge.

## The two rights side by side

| Right | What the patient may do | Time or charge |
|---|---|---|
| Amendment, where the request type allows an amendment request | Ask to amend information in the released record | Acted on within the type's amendment period, in calendar days |
| Accountings of disclosures | Obtain accountings of disclosures | The first accountings in a rolling 12 months, up to the type's free number, are free of charge |

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

On a hypothetical request type offering one free accounting in a rolling 12 months, a patient who obtained no accounting in the previous 12 months receives the next one free of charge; a patient who already obtained one in that period has used the free accounting.
